# Dayloop v0.12.0-rc11

This candidate tightens the calendar marker and gives each guide pack its own loading transition.

- Keeps the P5R calendar `TODAY` notice on one line, with larger type and an intentionally oversized pasted-card silhouette.
- Adds a red slash loading transition for the masks pack.
- Adds a rotating moon-and-orbit loading transition for the moon pack.
- Adds a pulsing crest/page loading transition for the crown pack.
- Holds the transition until the selected pack is ready and respects Android's remove-animations accessibility setting.
